spec.assertion: it.skip — v1 has no HP pool (immortal team) so HP lost is always 0, and defPct is documented inert. Asserted only via the strip-defensive inertness test (removing it must leave all four totals byte-identical).

Structural: single flatDamage 47.18 on a hitCount:5 (or shotFired+everyN:5) trigger, target enemy, swapGate 'swapped', core false. Behavioural: base > noRider proves it fires AND that the swap actually goes live; riderUngated > base proves the swap gate is genuinely closed outside her 10s window (RED under an ungated rider); riderEvery1 > base proves the 5-hit threshold binds (RED under a smaller count).

Structural: one burstCdr 20s, target self, trigger passive ('when Raptures appear' = battle start, NOT an event trigger). Behavioural: base burst-cast count >= noFervor, with a strict win on casts or team damage — RED under a no-op/oncePerBattle-only encoding. FLAG: 'continuously' means a permanent 40->20s cooldown floor; burstCdr is a one-shot subtraction, so a t=0 passive only helps her first cast. No primitive exists for a standing cooldown reduction.
it.skip — no taunt/aggro primitive and the boss deals no damage. Covered by the no-silent-drops test (must appear in note/unmodeled).

it.skip — the HP-threshold trigger is unreachable in v1, and a self Max HP grant is offensively inert without an atkOfMaxHpPct consumer (moran has none). Covered by no-silent-drops + strip-defensive inertness.

spec.kitLine: FB-enter in Fervor: allies CD down 7.48s
spec.assertion: Structural: burstCdr 7.48 on fullBurstEnter, target allies without excludeSelf — RED under the nearest-wrong burstCast keying (which would fire only on rotations moran herself bursts) and under a self-only target. Behavioural: fullBurstStart count base >= noFbCdr with a strict win on FB count or team damage, proving the CDR actually accelerates the rotation. Fervor is permanent from t=0, so the status gate is always satisfied and is intentionally not modeled as a separate gate.

Structural only: weaponSwap damagePct 14.7, durationSec 10, target self. Deliberately NOT asserted by totals — 14.7 vs her base normalAttackMultiplier 14.71 makes the swap near damage-neutral, so a totals delta could not discriminate it. Its liveness is proven indirectly: the swapGate'd 47.18% rider fires (base > noRider). Swap-window shot economy (pulls/sec of the changed weapon) is kit-silent and flagged, not asserted.

Structural: one unlimitedAmmo, durationSec 10. Behavioural: removing it must add reloads or cost moran damage (her 60-round magazine is roughly one 10s window, so the saving is real) — RED if the line was dropped as 'defensive'.

Must be present as a heal effect OR explicitly documented in note/unmodeled. Damage-inert here (self-targeted lifesteal, no HP pool), but heal/lifesteal lines are on-recovery tandem channels and must never be silently dropped.
it.skip — no taunt primitive. Covered by the no-silent-drops documentation test.

This is a DEFENSIVE ally buff, NOT the boss 'Damage Taken up' debuff. The strip-defensive run removes any damageTakenPct/defPct/maxHp* buff and asserts all four totals are byte-identical to base — RED if it was mis-encoded as a positive boss debuff, which would inflate the entire team.

spec.kitLine: DEF up 14.85% of user DEF, allies
spec.assertion: No caster-scaled DEF stat exists and defPct is inert; required to be documented (no-silent-drops) and covered by the strip-defensive byte-identity assertion.

spec.kitLine: ATK up 42.57% of user ATK, allies
spec.assertion: The unit's only damage-bearing team line. Structural: stat casterAtkPct (RED under target-scaled atkPct), durationSec 10, target allies without excludeSelf, trigger burstCast (RED under fullBurstEnter, which over-fires on rotations she does not cast). Behavioural: the buff value is identified by diffing base against the removal run (no unit-index guessing), then asserted FLAT-resolved (not the raw 42.57) and landing on all 4 slugs including self; removal drops team damage; a 20s-duration patch strictly beats base, proving the 10s window binds; the atkPct model produces a different team total, proving the stat choice is not vacuous.

fixtures: controlComp('moran', true) only — liter(B1) / crown(B2) / moran(B1 carry) / helm(B3), 180s, deterministic, no seed. helm=true is REQUIRED: moran is Burst I, so without helm the comp has no Burst III and no chain would complete. 11 hoisted runs (1 base + 10 counterfactuals). Ally identification is done by DIFFING event streams rather than by guessing moran's unit index, so the assertions survive any comp ordering. FLAGGED FIXTURE RISK: liter is also Burst I; if the engine allows only one B1 cast per rotation, moran may never burst and every burst-slot claim would be vacuous — the second test ('moran really casts her burst') is ordered first so this fails loudly and unambiguously rather than silently passing. If it fails, the fixture needs a B1-free control comp, not a spec change. NOTE ON DELIVERY: this role was executed with NO tool access, so the two artifact files (scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/moran.test.ts and moran.test-spec.json) could not be written to disk — testSource above is the complete file contents for the orchestrator to save.
gaps: S1a 'DEF up 3.51% continuously for every 1% of HP lost' — no HP-loss tracking (immortal team in v1) and defPct is inert; doubly unobservable.
S2a 'Taunts for 4 sec' on the final bullet, and burst 'Attract: Taunts all enemies for 10 sec' — no taunt/aggro primitive; the boss deals no damage so aggro is unobservable.
S2b Perseverance Max HP tiers (91% / 69.84% / 51.09%, once per battle each) — the HP-below-20% trigger is unreachable, and the grant is offensively inert (moran has no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer).
Burst 'Damage Taken down 35.14%' and 'DEF up 14.85% of the skill user's DEF' — defensive-only; no caster-scaled DEF stat exists.

Fervor modeled as a CONTINUOUS cooldown reduction: burstCdr is a one-shot subtraction, so a standing 40s -> 20s cooldown FLOOR has no primitive. Flagged, magnitude is kit-literal (20 sec); a t=0 passive burstCdr only shortens her FIRST cast and under-credits every later one.
Weapon-swap shot economy (pulls/sec, whether the changed weapon keeps AR cadence) is kit-silent — flagged, deliberately not asserted.
